user.title: Controme Setup
user.description: Choose how your Controme system should be found.

manual_entry.title: Controme Connection
manual_entry.description: Enter the address and the credentials of your Controme system. The credentials are only checked when a temperature is set.

data_description.api_url: Address of the Controme system, e.g. http://192.168.1.100 (http:// is added if missing).
data_description.user: Username of a Controme user that may change temperatures.
data_description.password: Password of this Controme user. The credentials are only checked when something is written (e.g. a temperature is set), not during setup.
data_description.haus_id: House ID of the Controme system (usually 1).

credentials.title: Controme Credentials
credentials.description: Found: {system}. Enter the credentials of your Controme system. The credentials are only checked when a temperature is set.

data_description.user: Username of a Controme user that may change temperatures.
data_description.password: Password of this Controme user. The credentials are only checked when something is written (e.g. a temperature is set), not during setup.
data_description.haus_id: House ID of the Controme system (usually 1).

select_system.title: Select Controme System
select_system.description: {count} Controme systems were found. Select one and enter its credentials. The credentials are only checked when a temperature is set.

data_description.api_url: Controme system found in the network.
data_description.user: Username of a Controme user that may change temperatures.
data_description.password: Password of this Controme user. The credentials are only checked when something is written (e.g. a temperature is set), not during setup.
data_description.haus_id: House ID of the Controme system (usually 1).

error.invalid_haus_id: The house ID may only contain digits (e.g. 1).
error.no_systems_found: No Controme system was found automatically. Please enter the details manually.

init.title: Controme Options
init.description: Settings for the transmission monitoring of the Controme sensors.

data_description.stale_threshold: Minutes without a transmission after which a sensor counts as stale (minimum 5, maximum 1440, default 15).

options.auto: Search the network for Controme systems automatically
options.manual: Enter IP address and credentials manually

set_temporary_temperature.name: Set temporary temperature
set_temporary_temperature.description: Sets a temporary target temperature for the selected Controme rooms, each room separately. The duration is only approximate (Controme may end it earlier). Setting the temperature normally (climate.set_temperature) ends the temporary value. Controme reports no status of the temporary mode.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Temporary target temperature (5-30 °C in steps of 0.5).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Approximate duration in minutes (1-1440). Without a duration Controme uses its default duration.

auth_failed.message: Authentication failed. Check the Controme username and password.

write_failed.message: Controme did not accept the change ({error}).

not_a_room.message: Room ID {room_id} is not a real Controme room (floor without rooms or room without ID), so nothing can be set for it.

hvac_mode_not_supported.message: The HVAC mode cannot be switched to {mode} from Home Assistant. Change the operation mode in Controme.

invalid_write_target.message: Refused to send a change that does not target exactly one Controme room.
